d:
A beautiful melody filled with romance and rhythm! Enjoy O Milan Maujon Se Maujon Ka from the superhit film Tohfa (1984), featuring the ever-charming Sridevi and Jeetendra. Sung by the legendary voices of Asha Bhosle and S.P. Balasubrahmanyam, with music composed by Bappi Lahiri and lyrics penned by Indeevar, this song brings back the magic of 80s Bollywood romance.
